info.name: Sharek Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for all backend endpoints currently implemented in the NestJS project.

request.description: Imports a GitHub repository and auto-fetches title, description, languages, tags, technologies, and statistics. Supports saving as unpublished (draft) or published.

item.name: Contribution Requests
item.description: Complete #48/#49 Contribution Request workflow. Set projectId to an owned, published Project UUID and run Applications / 01 - Login Owner first. Create Draft saves contributionRequestId automatically. Run Discard with a separate draftContributionRequestId; run Cancel only after any Application checks you want to perform.

item.name: 00 - List Owned Project Requests by Status

request.description: Returns every owned Contribution Request grouped under draft, published, assigned, completed, cancelled, and discarded. All groups are always present. Works for owned archived Projects.
Create a private draft for an owned, published Project. The response ID is saved as contributionRequestId. Change the idempotency key before creating another draft.
Read a Contribution Request as its owner. Unknown and other-owner UUIDs return the same safe not-found response.
Update owner-controlled fields while the Request is still a draft. Reusing the key with a different payload returns an idempotency conflict.
Explicitly publish a complete draft after ownership, Project state, entitlement, monthly limit, and close-time checks.
Public feed of published Requests whose Applications Close Time is still in the future. Remove query parameters to list every actionable Request.
Public allowlisted detail with Required and Preferred Requirements classified separately. Draft, cancelled, terminal, and closed Requests return the same not-found code.
Terminally discard an unpublished draft. Create a second draft and copy its ID to draftContributionRequestId so the published workflow ID remains usable.
Cancel a published Request without deleting history. Pending Applications become REQUEST_CANCELLED atomically; terminal Applications remain unchanged. Run this after Application checks.

request.description: Submit an immutable new version in response to the latest revision request.
Enable or disable new Contribution Proposal intake for an owned Project.
Withdraw a pending proposal without deleting its version or audit history.
Submit one Application as an active contributor. Reuse applicationIdempotencyKey to test replay behavior.
List pending Applications as the owning Project owner. The request uses ownerAccessToken.
Inspect an Application as its contributor or the owning Project owner.
Withdraw a pending Application as its contributor. Reuse withdrawalIdempotencyKey to test replay behavior.
Accept one pending Application as the current Project owner. Reusing acceptIdempotencyKey returns the original Owner Decision and Assignment.
Decline a different pending Application with required non-blank feedback. The stored feedback is trimmed.
Create a moderation Report for explicit decline feedback as the affected contributor. This does not reopen or change the Application.
